title: App with CI/CD and observability
description: The request path is four nodes. Everything dashed is tooling around it: a deploy pipeline, and metrics, dashboards and alerts.

detail.why: The source of all request traffic.

detail.role: Terminates TLS and spreads requests over the fleet.
detail.why: One stable address in front of a changing fleet.
A stateless fleet that scales out under load.

operational-excellence.text: Every instance publishes request rate, errors and latency.
Replication lag is not monitored yet, so a stalled replica would go unnoticed.

detail.role: Holds the code and the pipeline definition.
detail.why: Every change is reviewed and traceable.

detail.role: Builds, tests and rolls out each change.
detail.why: Deploys are repeatable and need no manual steps.

operational-excellence.text: Instances are replaced in batches with health checks between them.

security.text: The pipeline can update this fleet only.

detail.role: Groups alerts and pages the on-call engineer.
detail.why: Humans only hear about problems that need them.

operational-excellence.text: Routes by severity and silences duplicates.

detail.role: Scrapes metrics from the app every 15 seconds and evaluates alert rules.
detail.why: Pull-based metrics keep the app simple.

operational-excellence.text: Fine enough to catch short incidents, cheap enough to keep for weeks.

detail.role: Draws dashboards from the metrics store.
detail.why: A shared picture of how the system is behaving.

operational-excellence.text: One set of dashboards for everyone on call.

links.label: HTTPS
links.detail: Requests arrive over HTTPS and the response returns on the same connection.

links.label: Round robin
links.detail: The balancer picks a healthy instance for each request.

links.label: Read / write
links.detail: Application queries over a private connection.

links.label: Push triggers
links.detail: A push or merge notifies the pipeline, which starts a run.

links.label: Deploys
links.detail: A successful run rolls the new version out to the fleet. It moves no request data.

links.label: Scrapes /metrics
links.detail: Prometheus initiates every call: it pulls metrics from each instance every 15 seconds. The arrow points from the side that starts the call.

links.label: Queries
links.detail: Dashboards run queries against the metrics store when someone opens them.

links.label: Fires alerts
links.detail: When a rule's condition holds for long enough, Prometheus sends an alert for routing.

trace.label: The balancer picks a healthy instance

prose.text: Requests flow from users through a load balancer to a scaled fleet and a database. A pipeline deploys the fleet, and Prometheus, Grafana and Alertmanager watch it.
